## Classical Botanical Monographs (Dravyaguna Shastra)

- **Kanchnar (Bauhinia variegata)**: Bark extract; Kashaya rasa, Sheeta virya; classical Gandamala and Granthi-hara (cyst dissolving) properties.
- **Ashoka (Saraca asoca)**: Bark; Kashaya-Tikta rasa; primary Artava-janana and uterine tonic herb.
- **Lodhra (Symplocos racemosa)**: Bark; astringent and anti-inflammatory; controls excessive bleeding and vaginal discharges.
- **Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus)**: Root; Madhura rasa, Sheeta virya; natural phytoestrogens supporting follicular development.
- **Shilajit (Asphaltum punjabianum)**: Purified mineral pitch; rich in fulvic acid; enhances mitochondrial energy (ATP) production and vitality.
- **Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)**: Root; adaptogen, anti-cortisol; increases stamina, vigor, and nervous system resilience.
- **Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris)**: Fruit; rejuvenator for the urinary and reproductive tracts; supports endogenous vitality.
- **Triphala**: Classical blend of Haritaki, Bibhitaki, and Amalaki; cleanses the gastrointestinal tract and gently regulates bowel movements.
